name: octen-deepseek-search
description: Live web search via Octen MCP (default when a key is set: search, news, business, place, pulse, broad, extract, image; video beta). Exa official hosted MCP at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp for keyless web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa. Mainland China / Chinese-web supplement via DeepSeek Search & Fetch. Kimi Code loads kimi.plugin.json; Cursor loads this file.

OCTEN_API_KEY.title: Octen API key
OCTEN_API_KEY.description: Secret API key from https://platform.octen.ai (or docs.octen.ai). Used only as ${OCTEN_API_KEY} in mcp.json; never commit the value.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.title: DeepSeek API key
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: Secret API key from https://platform.deepseek.com. Used only as ${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY} in mcp.json; never commit the value.
